zs-explain:
explain (analyze, timing off, summary on)
WITH am AS (SELECT complex_id, min(plat_plc collate svc.ko_ci) AS b FROM svc.lyr_sg_atch WHERE plat_plc ILIKE '%은평%' GROUP BY complex_id),
g AS (SELECT complex_id FROM svc.lyr_sg_cmap WHERE (complex_nm ILIKE '%은평%' OR rep_plat_plc ILIKE '%은평%' OR rep_road_addr ILIKE '%은평%') UNION SELECT complex_id FROM am)
SELECT v.complex_id FROM svc.lyr_sg_cmap v LEFT JOIN am ON am.complex_id = v.complex_id WHERE v.complex_id IN (SELECT complex_id FROM g)
ORDER BY v.dong_cnt DESC NULLS LAST, v.pnu_cnt DESC NULLS LAST, v.complex_id LIMIT 51

explain (analyze, timing off, summary on)
WITH am AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT complex_id, min(plat_plc collate svc.ko_ci) AS b FROM svc.lyr_sg_atch WHERE plat_plc ILIKE '%은평%' GROUP BY complex_id)
SELECT v.complex_id FROM svc.lyr_sg_cmap v LEFT JOIN am ON am.complex_id = v.complex_id
WHERE (v.complex_nm ILIKE '%은평%' OR v.rep_plat_plc ILIKE '%은평%' OR v.rep_road_addr ILIKE '%은평%' OR am.complex_id IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY v.dong_cnt DESC NULLS LAST, v.pnu_cnt DESC NULLS LAST, v.complex_id LIMIT 51
